info.title: language/platform-agnostic locator healing: JSON in, JSON out
info.description: Language- and platform-agnostic command-line locator healing: feed it two JSON UI-tree snapshots (any tool in any language can produce them), get a heal decision back as JSON - no C# project, no FlaUI/Playwright .NET reference required on the caller's side.

options.name: --expected
options.description: A single UiElementInfo JSON object: the stale/broken locator's last known snapshot.

options.name: --tree
options.description: A UiElementInfo JSON tree: a freshly captured snapshot of the live application.
